mensaje_final: You finished block A! Now you know how to move around the board.

explicacion: The chessboard is a square with 64 squares: eight rows and eight columns.
The columns, called files, have letters, from a to h, from left to right. The rows, called ranks, have numbers, from 1 to 8, from your side towards your opponent's side.
Each square is named by its letter and its number. For example, e4 is the square on file e and rank 4.
Move with the arrow keys: NVDA will tell you which square you are on. When you reach the square you are asked for, press Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: You are on a1, the bottom left corner. Go to h1, the bottom right corner, and press Enter.
pistas: Use the right arrow: each time you press it, you move one file.
Press the right arrow seven times and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Now go up to h8, the top right corner, and press Enter.
pistas: The up arrow moves one rank towards your opponent's side.
Press the up arrow seven times and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Go to the square e4 and press Enter. It is one of the squares in the center of the board.
pistas: First find file e with the right or left arrow; then go up to rank 4.
e is the fifth file: from a1, press the right arrow four times and the up arrow three times.

ejercicios.instruccion: Go to d5 and press Enter.
pistas: d5 is very close to e4: one file to the left and one rank up.
Press the left arrow once, the up arrow once and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: A trick: the keys 1 to 8 take you to that rank without changing the file. Go to b7 by pressing the 7 key, and then Enter.
pistas: Press the 7 key on the number row, the one above the letters.
Press 7 and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Squares are light or dark, alternating. The square a1 is dark. Go to another dark square on rank 1 and press Enter. With F3 you can ask for the color of any square.
pistas: If a1 is dark, b1 is light. What will c1 be?
c1, e1 and g1 are dark. Go to any of them.

explicacion: Besides ranks and files, the board has diagonals: lines of squares that touch at their corners. All the squares of a diagonal have the same color.
For example, from a1 a diagonal goes up through b2, c3, d4, e5, f6, g7 and h8. To move along a diagonal with the keyboard, press one arrow up and another one to the side.
The four center squares are d4, e4, d5 and e5. They are very important: a piece in the center reaches more squares than one on the edge.

ejercicios.instruccion: You are on a1. Go to the next square of the diagonal, b2, and press Enter.
pistas: A diagonal step is one step up and one step to the right at the same time.
Press the up arrow, the right arrow and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Keep going along the same diagonal up to d4 and press Enter.
pistas: After b2 comes c3, and then d4.
Repeat twice: up arrow and right arrow.

ejercicios.instruccion: The other long diagonal goes from h1 to a8. Go to the square of that diagonal that is on rank 4 and press Enter.
pistas: From h1, the diagonal goes up to the left: g2, f3…
It is e4.

ejercicios.instruccion: Visit the four center squares, d4, e4, d5 and e5, and press Enter on each one. The order does not matter.
pistas: The four are together, forming a square in the middle of the board.
You still need: {faltan}.

ejercicios.instruccion: Four diagonals start from e4. Go to the end of the one that goes up to the right and press Enter.
pistas: Go up one rank and one file to the right, again and again, until you cannot go any further.
f5, g6 and h7. It is h7.

explicacion: At the start of a game, each side has 16 pieces: a king, a queen, two rooks, two bishops, two knights and eight pawns.
White takes ranks 1 and 2; black, ranks 7 and 8.
On rank 1, from a to h, there are: rook, knight, bishop, queen, king, bishop, knight and rook. The eight pawns stand in front, on rank 2. Black is set up the same way, facing them.
A trick to remember: the queen starts on a square of her own color. The white queen is on d1, which is light; the black queen, on d8, which is dark.

ejercicios.instruccion: Go along rank 1, from a1 to h1, with the right arrow. Listen to each piece. When you reach h1, press Enter.
pistas: Go to the right until the last square of the rank.
Press the right arrow until h1 and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Go to the white king and press Enter. Trick: the K key jumps to your king.
pistas: The king is next to the queen, on rank 1.
Press K and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Now go to the black queen and press Enter. Trick: Shift with Q jumps to your opponent's queen.
pistas: The black queen is on rank 8, on a dark square.
Press Shift+Q and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Where are the white knights? Go to one of them and press Enter.
pistas: The knights are next to the rooks.
Press N and then Enter.

ejercicios.instruccion: Go to the square right in front of the black king, the one its pawn is on, and press Enter.
pistas: The black king is on e8. In front of it, from its side, is rank 7.
It is e7: press 7 from file e.
